name: buffer
description: Buffer MCP server with 41 tools: 24 reads and 17 confirmed mutations.
long_description: Current schema-generated GraphQL operations with private named credentials, shared mandatory mutation confirmation and read-only enforcement. Includes local previews and bounded read pagination. Provider account and GUI outcomes are validated separately.

token_file.title: Private token-only file
token_file.description: Absolute regular owner-only token file, at most 64 KB. Never bundle it.

read_only.title: Read only
read_only.description: Hide and refuse all native and generic GraphQL mutations.

api_key.title: Private Buffer API key
api_key.description: API key from your account; leave empty for token_file.

allow_operations.title: Allow explicitly confirmed account operations
allow_operations.description: Allow only explicitly confirmed mutations; read-only still takes precedence.

organization_id.title: Default organization ID
organization_id.description: Optional input default only; does not restrict the account-wide permissions of a PAT.
